SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ......
Section 2, Special Branch Station.
REPORT
Date 13th November 1935.
Subject Communist propaganda found in the Dong Shing (同興) Cotton
Mill, 1433 Gordon Road (Pootoo Road District).
Made by T.S.I. Shih Ssu-chien. Forwarded by [签名]

Attached herewith are two communist handbills which were
delivered through the post addressed to Wong Ping H-sing (王炳星),
Dong Shing (同興) Cotton Mill, 1433 Gordon Road. As there is
no one answering to this name employed with the mill it is
surmised that the name is a fictitious one. Enquiries made at
post offices by detectives attached to Pootoo Road Station and
Special Branch have, however, failed to ascertain the place where
the literature was posted as the postal cancellation mark is
illegible. A summarized translation of the pamphlets is as
follows:-
(1). "Labourer's Weekly News (工人週刊)", issue No1, dated
5/10/35, purporting to have been issued by the "Labourers Press",
containing articles dealing with the following:-
(a). A fresh attack on China by the Japanese Imperialists
who are endeavouring to create a "Second Manchuokuo" in North
China. In this article the people are urged to kill all traitors
and members of the Kuomintang and to drive the Japanese Imperialists
out of China;
(b). General mobilization declared by Abyssinian Government
to resist the Italian invasion; and that 1,250,000 Abyssinian
soldiers have been sent to the front;
(c). Victories of Soviet Red Armies in Kansu, Western Hunan
and Western Hupeh;
(d). Anti-Fascist movement in France;
(e). War is imminent in the Mediterranean as both Great
Britain and Italy have mobilised battleships, aeroplanes and
submarines in that region;
(f). A number of Japanese soldiers killed in Mukden as a
result of an attack launched on them by volunteers.

containing the following articles:-

Japanese Imperialists in attacking the Soviet Armies in North
West China;
(b). The International Anti-war movement is working at

(c). Gas bombs have been dropped in Abyssinia by

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Pootoo Road Station,
REPORT
Date. 16.11.35. 19
Subject Communist Papers found in the Letter Box of Dong Shing Cotton Mill,
1433 Gordon Road.
Made by D.S.I. Hutton. Forwarded by Wmartins S.I

Sir,
I beg to report that 2 papers of an Anti-Japanese and
communistic nature were delived at the Dong Shing Cotton Mill,
1433 Gordon Road. From enquiries made by S.I. Koga, it was
ascertained that at 5 p.m. 15.11.35, a mill foreman named Mr.
Hashimoto collected the letters from the mill mail box and found
a package addressed to one named Wong Ping Maing (王炳明).
It was ascertained that no such person was known at the mill and
Mr. Hashimoto opened the package and found it to contain the 2
enclosed copies of the Labourers Weekly Publication. The
papers were handed over to S.I. Koga at 9 a.m. 16.11.35.
Detectives were sent to the Post office but the post mark could
not be traced.

W Hutton
D.S.I.

D.D.O. "B" Division.
